notes.title: A little update!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8805370/422211534b5783d8a965b75b2ecae4523fa61efe.jpg[/img]

Hey everyone!

Just wanted to make a quick announcement to let you know what we're up to!

We promised to have the Steam build ready really close to the Switch launch, but after releasing on the Nintendo portable we received a lot of feedback. Most of it was great, people loved the game and the story. But at the same time some people commented on melee, and how it wasn't up to par with the rest of the game.

So we've decided to revamp melee to make it as awesome as the rest of the game.

This means the full version of Tanzia needs a little more time in the oven...

But as promised, you can access the beta build on Steam right now, and play what's practically the same content as we have on Switch!

If you want to play the beta content right now, this is what you need to do:

/On your Steam library, right click on Tanzia, select "properties".
/Go to the "Betas" tab
/On the dropdown menu select "beta"
/Close the properties window and let Tanzia update.
Now Tanzia on your library should say "Tanzia [beta]". You can start playing the beta! : )

We're really sorry about all the delays, but as you know we're only two guys working full time on Tanzia, and only one of us is a programmer!

Thank you for being patient!

If you have any questions for us or if you want to chat about the details of Tanzia, drop by our [url=https://discordapp.com/channels/347828205077397522/347828205690028033] Discord.[/url]

notes.title: Tanzia Early Access Release - 4/27/2017!
notes.notes:
Good news everybody! We have a Steam Early Access release date!

[h1][b]4/27/2017![/b][/h1]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8805370/a89b3aade2662bd1ef7ebe29a600b4b70a0ad83d.png[/img]
Finally, after years of hard work, we're ready to let our baby fly! You will be able to get your hands on Tanzia at the end of April!

Why Early Access?
We feel like at this point the first chapters of the game are nearly finished, the game runs well, streamers and testers are having fun with it, so we want to let you enjoy it early while we finish the later stages.

Our plans for EA.
[list]
[*]The first EA build will feature all but the last few chapters.

[*]We'll release the last few chapters during Early Access.

[*]We can't announce a date for every update and the full release right now, but our intention is that no more than a couple of weeks should pass between updates.

[*]We´ll do small updates in between in case of bugs.

[*]You'll be able to keep playing after you reach the end of each build, if you want to level up or do sidequests.
[/list]

We're only 16 days away for the Steam Early Access launch! It's so close we can almost taste it...

Please help us out telling everyone you know, retweet the tweets, share the facebooks (?), scream at your neighbors, write to the editors of your favorite gaming sites, message your favorite Youtubers and Twitch streamers!
People need to know about Tanzia, or the Skeleton King wins!

Can't wait to finally see you all playing! : D

notes.title: Build #2863 Small but Important Update
notes.notes:
Hey everybody! This time we're releasing one of the most requested features and some very important general fixes and balancing. Let me walk you through them.

[b]Sell items[/b]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8805370/4225e28a9230da73d3076fa75e845a08e26a40d5.png[/img]
Since version 00001 everyone with access to the game have been asking us to let them sell unused items and reagents, and now it's finally possible! Every merchant in the game has a little sell icon, click on it and it switches to your inventory, easy!
And no, you can't sell the whistle, we have plans for it ; )

[b]Steam Cloud Saves[/b]
Everyone hates losing progress, now with cloud saves that's a thing of the past! It's like we live in the future!

[b]Boss music[/b]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8805370/e8ece8bf0e712ee6f45d9d632910c4cd7b741e68.jpg[/img]
[i]Not this boss[/i]
Everything is more exciting with boss music right?

We're getting so close to the Early Access launch announcement you guys! We can practically taste it... Stay tuned!

Here's the full changelog for build #2863

4/4/2017 P4 #2863
-add "sell to merchants" functionality.
-add xp bonus/penalty depending on monster's level diff.
-add Steam cloud saves.
-add boss music.
-added environment/discovery music for some zones that were missing music.
-big final pass on Alchemy.
  -removed silver, brittlebright, and crispin's glove.
  -rebalanced recipes.
  -added reagent spawns to some bare areas.
  -made Bear Island a reagent haven.
  -rebalanced items among alchemy merchants.
-add Tika's Restoration side quest, potion, and recipe.
-updates to minimap.
-add missing berserk icon.
-fix the bug where if you start casting a spell and then immediately hit melee, the spell fizzles!
-FIX: you can fall off the edge of the world by jumping over the walls of the Lower Temple (Library).
-FIX: you can see bright blue sky through the walls if you stand on a bookcase in the Library and jump.
-fix big pot holes in The Docks paths.
-fix pathing issues on some mobs.
-fixed several canoe issues.
  -FIX: no regen in canoe when in totem range.
  -FIX: if you get into a canoe with totem regen on, the particle fx stays on you but no regen happens.
  -FIX: you can aggro stuff and take damage in a canoe, but can't die.
  -FIX: you can fall through the world exiting the canoe at several places at Sinking Island.
-fix issue where boat guy will keep taking your 5 gold and renting you the boat everytime you talk to him.
-fix bug where you could bring up inventory while a vision was pending, causes strange behavior.
-don't allow interactions while vision is pending. Smart interaction path was bypassing this.
-Fix bug where you can't use enchanted feathers during lost staff chapter.
-FIX: when returning with silver, map marker for Moku is in the wrong place.
-fix bug where you can't interact with Mowg trainer using auto-interact button.
-fix bug where you can't interact with Tika at all after turning down her quest.

notes.title: Gamepad Update! (And more, plenty more!)
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! You wouldn’t believe how hard we worked on this update, we’re super happy to finally show it to you!


Here’s what’s new:


[b]Gamepad Controls[/b]
Finally! After weeks (months?) of tweaking and testing and swearing and breaking and fixing (and crying), we present you, the gamepad update!
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8805370/7d3fc8bcae9e1716d7d08e9f831c00827b1c6a52.png[/img]
So now you can choose between the regular MMO-Style controls we all love, a FPS-style variant (where the mouse moves the camera automatically, without keeping the right button pressed).
And gamepad! Yes! You’ll be able to modify it as you please, invert it, change all the key bindings, you can even bind your spells to the digital pad and have them right at your fingertips!

By default we have two presets A and B, A was created by our lead designer Jason, and B was created by a normal person (me, Matias), so you might want to switch to B to have a better experience ; )

Think of the gamepad controls as in Beta (a Beta inside another Beta? how meta!) so things might break, please send us your feedback and comments so we can keep improving it.


[b]Tabs in the Equipment Menu[/b]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8805370/9cdb3e5e212a76d03e0e53381b680abff7583d50.png[/img]
After lots of requests, we added tabs to the equipment menu. That used to be a big mess and people needed to navigate pages and pages to find what they were looking for, but now everything is tidy and organized!


[b]Auto Targeting[/b]
If you were one of the players who hated the “you don’t have a target” pop-up text, you’re in luck! Now if you aggro an enemy, the game will target it automatically, and if that enemy dies, and there’s another aggroed enemy around, the game will target that one.
So unless you start picking up loot or talk to an NPC, then you’ll always have a target and the fight will never stop! You’re going to love it! (I know I do!).


[b]Z-targeting / Enemy lock[/b]
Mastering kiting is super important in Tanzia (keeping an enemy chasing you while also keeping it at a range where it cannot attack you), you really need it if you plan on surviving the Emuri Village or any of the later areas. It’s super hard to kite properly using a gamepad, so we added a way to lock the camera to your target, so you can run around it and not destroy your fingers in the process. If you played Zelda64, you’ll feel right at home.


[b]Melee changes[/b]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8805370/81ed2e811042d748d99a3cb185c159cda40f99a4.png[/img]
Before, melee was treated like a spell, so you activated it, and waited for it to cool down to attack again. Now it works independently, you can attack at any time even if you don’t have a target. Using the gamepad you have a dedicated button for the attack, and best of all, now you can do a little 3-hit combo, it’s fun!


[b]We killed the pre-launcher[/b]
All the options that you used to find on the pre-launcher, now you’ll find on the settings menu.
So now Tanzia is 100% compatible with Steam’s Big Picture Mode. You can sit back, relax, and play on your couch : D


That’s it for the big changes, now the full changelog for build #2607:

1/24/2017 P4 #2607
-gamepad/controller support!
-Steam Big Picture compatibility!
-equipment screen tabs to filter by item type.
-greatly improved controls configuration.
-added video settings screen.
-the bridge demon should hit you if you're on the bridge, even before chapter 3.
-fix bug where you can still attack when dead.
-added item count to hotbar.
-prevent bear from entering canoe.
-fix HUD spam that happens sometimes when Necromancer's Jewel is equipped.
-allow player to walk in the village pond.
-restore health and mana when you level.
-add a note from grandfather to the Overwatch Stone chest.
-modify the crab whistle effect for easier herding.
-add more crab spawns to The Docks.
-improve Overwatch Stone FX to help player visually notice when it fires and understand what it's doing.
-make the scroll for the purify platform glow a bit so it's more obvious.
-flatten the purify platform a bit so you can walk onto it without jumping.
-don't let player attack General Rotwart without speaking to him first.
-fix target FX height on the potion merchant in The Village.
-fix bug in Alchemy book where if you buy a new recipe and open the alchemy book, the recipe that's shown doesn't match the page until after you turn the page once.
-fix zombie boss portrait camera.
-fix bug where stone guardians fall through the world when you die.
-attempt to fix bug where stone guardian stops fighting sometimes.
-add tutorial popup that explains saving.
-turn down the music volume in The Docks.
-set demon shadowstepper to level 4 instead of level 1.
-prevent multiple visions from queuing up at once.
-fix bug where you could kill the demon shadowstepper before triggering the vision and then he'd respawn.
-add more saves to intro.
-add "when not in combat" to the totem tutorial popup.
-leave the quest description up while in the quest journal.
-allow interaction clicks to go through the PC.
-move a bunch of stuff out of the TODO list and into a new list for the January beta update.
-Corrupt boar doesn't spawn anymore after you defeat him.
-fix bug where Tika's feathers don't work if you haven't done the Madda quest yet.
-fixed several missing off-quest dialogs to various NPCs.
-just limit Alchemy potion purchases to 1. The doubling price confuses and angers people.
-add movement tutorial popups for each type of control scheme.
-use Darker sprite for dropdowns so the background doesn't interfere with readability.
-fix bug where you can't bind mouse buttons to actions.
-add 3-hit combo to melee.
-fix bug where you can use spells while in bear form (Thanks Gixxy!).
-make it so you can't melee stuff that's behind the character.
-tighten up the angle on what's considered "in front" of the character for melee.
-add a 0.1f default wait time when skipping NPC dialog to avoid accidental double-click skipping.
-take damage is now just a 50% additive animation that blends over everything but death. Works great! For instance if you get hit while swinging, you still keep swinging but the PC jolts a bit and the swing looks a bit more wild.
-add autorun for JD the Curmudgeon.
-added some helpful merchant chatter.
-added some villager chatter.
-instead of dropping Erudi's bags from treasure chests and stuff, use an actual 3D bag model.
-erudi's bag quest shouldn't require finding hidden vase easter-egg to complete.  Make 5 bags complete the quest.
-add some passive life on Sinking Island.
-add invert Y option for mouselook.
-add Lost Staff vision.
-add Rotwart vision.
-add Mowg vision.
-add Forgotten Jungle vision.
-add Arexis vision.
-raise damage on Lost Staff.  It was lower than the Enchanted Staff!

notes.title: November Update Part Deux, it’s All About The Gems!
notes.notes:
Hey everybody! Another update! And this one is special!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8805370/5c05afd06797aee0a4759e4fde7e303890b697fa.png[/img]

[h1]Gems[/h1]
Yes! As of this build, you’ll be able to implant gems to your staff!
To do that, you need to either loot or buy a gem, go to one of the jewelry tables that you’ll find around the island, and implant and extract gems at will.
Remember that each staff has a different amount of gem slots, so use them wisely!

[h1]Visions[/h1]
Now the visions you experience during gameplay have voice over and are also easier to understand, players used to think that they were cutscenes of stuff happening right at that moment, but they are in fact visions of what you're supposed to do in the future, to either advance in the game or make your life easier i.e. “Learn Fireball”.
We’re still working on the tutorial quests to make them more involved and engaging, the new visions are the first step in that direction!
Not all the visions are implemented in this build, so keep checking these updates out!

Here's the full changelog for build #2475

11/23/2016
Build #2475
-new gem system!
-add Jeweler's Workbench for gem crafting.
-add gem merchants.
-add gem inventory to some existing merchants.
-add gem drops to some bosses.
-add rare gems to some treasure chests.
-first 5 visions final-ish!
-move tutorial vision to immediately after staff purchase.
-move Akiri vision to immediately after acquiring enough gold to buy fireball.
-raise Ancient Temple respawn times to 30 minutes.
-added  treasure chests surrounding the giant widow.
-Tika on Bear Island now sells more stuff including Enchanted Feathers.
-add Emuri scout camp to the 2 treasure chests at Turtle Beach by the Crossroads.
-Fixed: Invincibility does not stop poison damage.
-Fixed: Treasure Chest at The Docks doesn't open.
-add a backup canoe to sinking island to prevent getting stranded.
-fix hp update after death bug.
-fix map reveals not saving sometimes bug.

notes.title: September Update, New Locations, New Weapons, Tons of Fixes!
notes.notes:
I know we're in October already! But we're just starting the month, so it's fair to name it like that! ; )

Here's what you came for, the update list!

[h1][b]Temple Ruins[/b][/h1]
You'll finally be able to open the door that takes you to the Temple Ruins! Beware of the zombies! And also make sure to bring the key to open it from the Forgotten Jungle...

[h1][b]Sinking Island[/b][/h1]
Another island! I hope you've been working on your upper body strength, because you have to row to get there!
What's waiting for you there? We won't tell, but it will really come in handy for the rest of your adventure.

[h1][b]Ancient Library[/b][/h1]
I wanted to write something funny about returning ancient overdue books, but the place is scary enough as it is without grumpy librarians and late fees, you´ll see!


That's for the locations, we also have a ton of improvements for you to try.

[h1][b]Corpse looting[/b][/h1]
The number one request we get from every streamer is that when you slain a big enemy, sometimes it's body covers the loot bags, so you'd have to click around blindly to find it.
NO MORE! Now you can directly click on the corpse, you'll get the loot and the body will disappear! Like magic!

[h1][b]New Camera System[/b][/h1]
Before the camera was always at a fixed distance behind you, but now it will react to the environment pulling it close to you if there's a wall or any other object, so now it won't clip behind stuff like it used to! Fancy!

[h1][b]The Hotbar[/b][/h1]
Now it won't let you pull items from it while you're playing (this is for you, Arbitrarium!) so the players that click and drag won't have any more problems while fighting!

We have more in store for the next few weeks, stay tuned!

Full Change log:

10/10/2016
-Temple Ruins is open!
-The mysterious Sinking Island is open!
-You can now click on a corpse to loot it instead of having to try to find the sometimes impossible loot bag.
-New camera controller to keep camera from clipping through environment geometry.
-Many changes you can't see yet (and a few that you can but shouldn't!) until the upcoming gems system is enabled.
-Don't allow drag/drop of hotbar items unless we're in the equipment or spells window.
-Fix positions of map markers for Forgotten Jungle quests.
-Fix bugged map markers on Haste quest.
-Add missing dropset to Arexis.
-Add missing map reveal for Forgotten Jungle.
-Major framerate optimizations in some areas.
-Fixed bug: inventory icons shouldn't MIP.
-Builds are now labeled with build number.
-Show simple error message when trying to use an item from inventory while the item is on cooldown.
-Add sound fx for boar, skeletons, skeleton mages.
-Limit Arexis potions to 2 or 3 of each because some people reach him and just spam the buy button til all their gold is gone
-Always show "Buy" button on merchant GUI.  Let them know they don't have enough gold when they click it.
-Madda and Mowg should now popup merchant window automatically at the end of the conversation after quest completion.
-Fix several issues with passage guardian.
-Fix bug where you can't hit thunderclap if you're OOM during mako's rage.
-Fix bug where you can't save at docks totem if you're on the edge of town.
-Fix bug: Madda says "Merchant" everytime you click on him once he's in merchant mode.
-Fix bug: Madda and Mowg shouldn't disappear and fade in after they convert from quest mode to merchant mode.
-FireTotem now only attacks targets that are aggroed on the pc.
-Fixed a collision bug at Giant Widow.
-Added code to slide down slopes and got rid of the goofy code that tries to keep you from jumping up cliffs by changing your jump vector.
-Fix memory leak.  release sound info objects when done with them.
-Make bees swarm on aggro instead of on death.
-Rename demon courier to demon shadowsteeper.



6/28/2016 P4 #2158
-The Lagoon is open!
-Bear Island is open!
-Forgotten Jungle is open!
-Bear Island boat is now running!
-add "return Kurame's boots to Kurame" task to the Kurame quest chain.
-fix issue where Abenaki disappears from The Village and there's nobody to un-pigify you.
-expand hotbar to 10 slots.
-use items directly from inventory.
-add a control bindings menu for control customization.
-add a global sound volume slider.
-add volume sliders for fx and ambient sounds.
-fix a bunch of ambient audio issues where ambient sounds don't respond to ambient volume level.
-add images for slides 0-1 and 2-1.
-prototype for first vision cutscene.
-mako's rage now resets all spell cooldowns when you use it so you can enjoy a more pleasant and uninterrupted rage experience.
-remove collision fence preventing drop down from crossroads.
-allow walking in turtle beach "lagoon".
-adjust collision fence at The Docks so you can go in the water by the waterfall.
-don't allow using invis potion during combat
-allow deleting of saved games.
-made Akura a little harder to melee.
-fix bug preventing completion of Erudi's bags quest.
-fix the Erudi's bag on the cliff bug where you can see it but can't get it before zoning out.
-fix bug where pig hotbar grays out permanently.
-fix bug where verdant blossom icon doesn't show up on journal map during haste quest.
-fix missing collision panel on the EmuriVillage->Lagoon bridge.
-fix a lighting/visual artifact bug causing you to see a big bright blue square projected over water near torches.
-fix bug where if you use see invis, save, reload, you don' t have the effect or the potion anymore.
-fix missing loincloth bug on starting armor.
-fix bug where ice comet is hitting NPCs.


5/5/2016 P4 #2006
-reduce root cooldown and mana cost.
-fix collision issues in The Village perimeter and gates.
-fix gap in perimeter collision at The Lagoon entrance (Thanks Druidic!).
-add portal to Turtle Beach.
-add notification when unlocking a portal.
-change wording on Haste to be less confusing (Thanks CVTTV!).
-fixed corrupt boar quest.
-now showing quest hint popup banner text for ALL quest updates.
-added quest journal.
-added map icons to show totem locations.
-added map icons to show relevant locations for currently selected quest.
-added tutorial popups for Intro chapter.
-fixed bug where monsters get stuck under bridges and docks sometimes.
-fix rejuvinate and regenerate bug that caused them to never wear off.
-lower regenerate and rejuvinate duration from 5 minutes to 2 minutes to match the description.
-raise cooldown on haste and invincibility.
-fix bug where you have no mouse cursor at some popup dialogs sometimes.
-Gatekeeper at The Village advises you if you're underequipped when you try to leave (Thanks Fiamma!).
-adjust HUD a tiny bit so that hint panel doesn't overlap with merchant windows.
-attempt to fix the bug where cutscenes kill audio sometimes.
-add better feedback to Arexis potions.



4/21/2016 P4 #1954
-fix the beta collision wall to prevent travel into The Lagoon.
-add Kurame magic boots quest.
-fix collision issues on Emuri Temple platform.
-hack to minimize bug where mobs fall below walkable models (msotly Skeletons at The Docks and Emuri High Priest)
-main menu work to allow saving/loading multiple games.

-root from root spell is now a blocking obstacle.

-restrict the game to 16:9 aspect ratios for now.
-fix bug where Erudi TAKES GOLD from you when you choose one of his quest reward potions.

-show totems on world map.
-add markers to the world map for main quest.
-The Docks undead combat balancing.
-Emuri Village combat balancing.
-demon imp at The Docks now has proper drops.
-combine Emuri Village and Emuri Temple into a single zone.
-increase Thunderclap cooldown to 60 seconds.
-double all town regen rates.
-fix some pathing issues in Emuri Village.
-fix collision hole that lets you walk under the boat dock at The Docks.
-fix a bug where The Village gates weren't opening.
-move potions and recipes from Bento's shop to The Docks shop and untie them frmo the Kurame's Challenges quest chain.
-update world map with some minor fixes.

notes.title: June Update
notes.notes:
Hey everybody! I'm here again to let you know about the changes we've made to Tanzia during May and June.

[h1]There's a ton of new content, so Here's a quick Summary:[/h1]

[b]The Lagoon:[/b] Yes, you can finally go and explore the Lagoon! Most people already visited the area because we opened it right after the last update. But we wanted to write it here for posterity.
Watch out for the bees though, they're poisonous!

[b]Bear Island:[/b] What? Another island? YES! And it's filled with brand new enemies that'll make the Emuri Village look like a florist convention (?). Complete the main quest there to get an awesome new ability (can't tell you what it is, but it rhymes with "Pear Scone"... sort of).
The boat at the Docks will take you there now after you finish the Lagoon quest.

[b]Forgotten Jungle:[/b] Welcome to the jungle, we've got fun 'n' games! Yeah! (Please don't sue us, Axel...).
The most mysterious place in the island, and you know what? You´ve passed it a hundred times already and never saw it!
Big secrets will be revealed there, so keep your eyes open. And also, good luck if you're arachnophobic! : P

[h1]Full Changelog:[/h1]
Since no one reads the full changelog, I added an item that doesn't belong, be the first to find it, post it on Twitter or Facebook and we'll give you a Tanzia beta key! (only one key!).
Good luck!

[*]add "return Kurame's boots to Kurame" task to the Kurame quest chain.

notes.title: May Update
notes.notes:
Hey everybody! Thanks for all the great feedback this past few weeks. We've fixed a ton of bugs and made some major improvements.

[h1]Here's a quick Summary:[/h1]

[b]The Quest Journal:[/b] Before, you had little clues on what your current mission was, it was serviceable, but sometimes a little confusing. Now with The Quest Journal, you can see all your current quests and if you click on each one it'll show you what you need to do and where you have to go, it's super handy! Try if if you haven't already, it's the topmost menu button, the one with the feather icon.

[b]Map Icons:[/b] Now the map is much easier to read, you have icons for the totems and for important things you need to find during your adventure, for example if you're into the crab quest and you go into The Quest Journal and select it, the map will show you where the crabs are, the same with most quests where you need to find something! You can summon the map pressing M or by selecting the map button on the menu, The Quest Journal will also show the map with quest related icons.

[b]The Emuri Village:[/b] That area was closed to beta users for super long and now you can go there! Some people already visited it and died there a lot, some went and kicked ass! Our advice before you set foot there is: Gear up! Or you're going to have a rude awakening!

[b]New lighting:[/b] We're still improving the visuals of the game a bit, and we just made some subtle lighting changes you might have noticed. It's not complete yet but you should see some flickering torches, character shadows and, if you have an artistic eye, much improved lighting all around to give Tanzia a much warmer and nicer look than before.

[b]Bug fixes and tweaks:[/b] We're always working on improving the game, there's a ton of under the hood changes/fixes we made based on feedback and all the videos we're watching from Lets Players and Streamers. We fixed quests & combat balance issues and every day we add new stuff to the list!

[h1]Full Changelog:[/h1]
The full programmery techy changelog for April is below. Make a game out of it. See how many lines you can read before your eyes cross and then try to break that record! Post your high scores on twitter!!! 

•	Add portal to Turtle Beach.
•	Add Kurame magic boots quest.
•	Main menu work to allow saving/loading multiple games.
•	Reduce fireball cost to 10 gold.
•	The Docks undead combat balancing.
•	Emuri Village combat balancing.
•	Add cleanse recipe to The Docks alchemy shop (Thanks Bacon!)
•	Root from root spell is now a blocking obstacle.
•	Double all town regen rates.
•	Reduce root cooldown and mana cost.
•	Allow saving at any totem instead of just in town.
•	Fixed corrupt boar quest.
•	Fix bug where you have no mouse cursor at some popup dialogs sometimes.
•	Fix the bug where cutscenes kill audio sometimes.
•	Add better feedback to Arexis potions.
•	Add notification when unlocking a portal.
•	Change wording on Haste to be less confusing (Thanks CVTTV!).
•	Now showing quest hint popup banner text for ALL quest updates.
•	Added tutorial popups for Intro chapter.
•	Gatekeeper at The Village advises you if you're under-equipped when you try to leave (Thanks Fiamma!).
•	Fixed bug where monsters get stuck under bridges and docks sometimes.
•	Fix collision issues on Emuri Temple platform.
•	Restrict the game to 16:9 aspect ratios for now.
•	Fix bug where Erudi TAKES GOLD from you when you choose one of his quest reward potions (Sorry Bacon!).
•	Demon imp at The Docks now has proper drops.
•	Fix some pathing issues in Emuri Village.
•	Fix collision hole that lets you walk under the boat dock at The Docks.
•	Fix a bug where The Village gates weren't opening.
•	Move potions and recipes from Bento's shop to The Docks shop and untie them from the Kurame's Challenges quest chain.
•	Adjust HUD a tiny bit so that hint panel doesn't overlap with merchant windows.
•	Fix collision issues in The Village perimeter and gates.
•	Fix gap in perimeter collision at The Lagoon entrance (Thanks Druidic!).
•	Fix the beta collision wall to prevent travel into The Lagoon.
•	Fix rejuvenate and regenerate bug that caused them to never wear off.
•	Lower regenerate and rejuvenate duration from 5 minutes to 2 minutes to match the description.
•	Raise cooldown on haste and invincibility.
•	Increase Thunderclap cooldown to 60 seconds.

Thank you for reading!
